name: Coral Cat's Claw
headline: Coral Cat's Claw
description: The Peruvian plant cat's claw has anti-inflammatory and immune-activating properties. Combined with burdock root and green tea it helps raise vitality and is useful during fatigue and general weakness.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule three times a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Cat's claw bark extract, burdock root extract, green tea leaf extract, excipients.
